metadata.name: Multi-temporal archive of Uelzen, Germany (Site c3126) satellite imagery and shapefiles
metadata.description: A multi-temporal archive for a single fixed observation site in Uelzen, Germany (Site ID: c3126). The dataset contains 285 records spanning 1984 to 2023, cataloging associated GeoTIFF satellite imagery and Shapefile data. The data structure is split into two subsets: records with date ranges and GeoTIFF file references (153 records), and records with Shapefile references but lacking specific date ranges (132 records).
